_help: Admissions requirements gathered from official university pages via search-result snippets on 2026-11-13 (the pages themselves couldn't be opened). Verify each item on the live page before relying on it. 'school' must match your program list.

programs.feeWaiver: Steinhardt waivers: financial hardship, returned Peace Corps, US military/veterans, Fulbright, IRT. Choose the category under 'Additional Information' and upload proof.
programs.gre: Pages conflict: FAQ says required for PhD; How to Apply allows a waiver request to ectinfo@nyu.edu before the deadline. Ask the program.
programs.englishTest: TOEFL / IELTS / Duolingo (successful applicants typically ~100 iBT; no formal minimum). Exemption needs 4 years of US/English-only study, so an MS or 1-year MA does NOT exempt you.
programs.sop: Up to 2,500 words: research questions, why ECT, which faculty fit, how the program serves your goals.
programs.letters: 3, addressing educational media/technology skills and readiness for graduate study.
programs.funding: Steinhardt Fellowship: $35,930 stipend (2026-27), tuition remission, health insurance, through year 5. TA/RA paid separately.
programs.cohort: Not stated (hundreds of applications a year).
programs.oneApp: Only ONE Steinhardt application per term (admissions email, Nov 11).

programs.englishTest: Same as ECT: an MS alone doesn't exempt you.
programs.sop: 2-3 pages, double-spaced; name the faculty you want to work with.
programs.writingSample: Required: course paper or equivalent, up to 20 pages.
programs.funding: Same Steinhardt package ($35,930 stipend 2026-27), no work duties beyond academics.
programs.oneApp: Only ONE Steinhardt application per term.

programs.program: PhD, Applied Linguistics and Multilingual Education
programs.deadline: Not found; sibling PhDs use Dec 1. Verify.
programs.englishTest: Same as ECT: an MS alone doesn't exempt you.
programs.writingSample: Required: up to 20 pages (needn't be on applied linguistics).
programs.cohort: Not stated. Requires a related master's, GPA 3.3+.
programs.oneApp: Only ONE Steinhardt application per term.

programs.deadline: TC-wide doctoral deadline Dec 1, 2026 (a program's own earlier date overrides). Verify.
programs.feeWaiver: US veterans, undergrad Pell-eligible, TC-affiliated orgs. Need-based: start the application, then email admission@tc.columbia.edu, subject 'Application Fee Waiver Request', with documents. Don't pay while waiting.
programs.gre: Not stated (most TC programs don't require it).
programs.englishTest: TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo within 2 years. Exempt with a completed graduate degree from an English-medium institution, so your UCL MA should qualify.
programs.sop: Program limit not stated. TC guidance: background, goals, contribution to TC.
programs.funding: Not guaranteed. A limited number of Doctoral Fellows get tuition scholarship + $30,000/yr for 3-4 years.
programs.oneApp: Only ONE active TC application per cycle: this rules out the Applied Linguistics EdD.

programs.deadline: TC-wide Dec 1, 2026; the program FAQ mentions a priority deadline (usually January) for aid. Verify.
programs.englishTest: TOEFL iBT 100 (or 5.0 new scale). Exempt with a completed English-medium graduate degree (UCL MA).
programs.funding: Not guaranteed; limited Doctoral Fellows ($30,000/yr). Many applicants are placed in the Ed.M. first (Waring).
programs.cohort: Not stated. Tracks: language use (Waring), SLA, assessment/technology.
programs.oneApp: Only ONE active TC application per cycle.

programs.deadline: Early December (exact date not found). Verify on the GSE deadlines page.
programs.fee: $75, waived automatically if you submit between Sept 1 and March 1.
programs.feeWaiver: Free Sept 1 to March 1. After that, email admissions@gse.upenn.edu with 'Waiver' in the subject.
programs.gre: An older GSE page says required for all PhDs. Unverified for 2027. Check.
programs.englishTest: TOEFL/IELTS; exempt with a degree from a sole-English-medium institution, so your UCL MA should qualify.
programs.sop: GSE: 750 words or less, tailored to the program (PhD-specific cap not confirmed).
programs.letters: 3; include an academic reference if you graduated in the last 5 years.
programs.funding: Fully funded 4 years: tuition, stipend, health insurance.
programs.cohort: Small and very competitive (Bodong Chen). Some applicants are invited to campus in February.
programs.oneApp: Multiple GSE programs allowed; use different recommenders per program (admissions email, Nov 10).

programs.gre: Same as LST: possibly required, unverified.
programs.funding: Guaranteed full scholarship 4 years + stipend + health insurance.
programs.cohort: 1-2 new students a year (Amy Stornaiuolo, Nov 13).
programs.oneApp: Multiple GSE programs allowed; different recommenders per program.

programs.englishTest: TOEFL/IELTS; exempt with a sole-English-medium degree.
programs.cohort: Not stated. Degree requires a second-language exam.
programs.oneApp: Multiple GSE programs allowed; different recommenders per program.

programs.deadline: Dec 1 = spring start; Apr 1 = summer/fall start. Apply by Dec 1 to be considered for funding.
programs.feeWaiver: No current College of Education waiver found.
programs.gre: Not stated (manuals mention GRE among reviewed materials).
programs.englishTest: TOEFL iBT 90 (sections 20/23/26/24) or Duolingo 120. Waived only after 2+ consecutive years at a US institution, so the in-progress Stanford MS may not count. Check.
programs.funding: Not guaranteed. TA/GA: up to 20 hrs/week, tuition remission up to 10 credits/semester, stipend amount not stated.

programs.program: PhD in Education, LCID (Learning Sciences / Language Education)
programs.deadline: Not stated for LCID; GSE says 'March 8 for most programs' (probably last cycle). Verify; your list says Dec 1.
programs.fee: Not stated on GSE pages (other Rutgers pages: $70).
programs.feeWaiver: Rutgers Graduate Admissions auto-reviews McNair, military/veterans, Rutgers alumni; Big Ten FreeApp for domestic applicants. Unconfirmed for GSE.
programs.englishTest: TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo (Duolingo 120). If your university taught in English, a confirmation letter may substitute.
programs.sop: Why a PhD in Education at Rutgers, research interests, which faculty and how your questions fit them, long-term plans. Length not stated.
programs.funding: Not guaranteed; all applicants considered for fellowships/GA/TA (full tuition remission + stipend), up to 5 years. File a FAFSA for GSE scholarships.

programs.deadline: Dec 15 for fall (funding considered by Dec 15); rolling after.
programs.feeWaiver: Attend an NJIT information session to get a fee-waiver code.
programs.gre: Required for Ying Wu College of Computing PhDs.
programs.englishTest: TOEFL iBT 79, IELTS 6.5 (no band below 6.0), Duolingo 120. Waiver for English-medium degree on the CS page; unconfirmed for DS.
programs.sop: Required; length not stated (CS asks for motivation, research interests, prior research).
programs.funding: Competitive TA/RA (tuition + stipend, 18 hrs/week), not guaranteed; expected to move to RA/external funding within 2 years.
programs.cohort: Not stated. Expects a quantitative bachelor's, GPA 3.5.

programs.feeWaiver: Only US veterans and McNair Scholars.
programs.gre: Temporarily suspended per the program page. Confirm for 2027.
programs.englishTest: TOEFL iBT or IELTS (no Duolingo). Exempt with a degree from an English-only institution in an English-speaking country, so UCL / completed Stanford degrees should qualify.
programs.sop: Personal statement: background, research interests, faculty fit, contribution. Non-psychology applicants explain why.
programs.funding: GC Fellowship ~$31,141/yr + ~$2,000 for 5 years (2025-26), including tuition; teach one course/semester from year 2.
programs.cohort: About 5-6 admitted a year, ~20-30% (2020-era FAQ). Interviews from February.
programs.oneApp: Only ONE doctoral program per cycle at the GC.

programs.program: PhD, Innovation in Curriculum and Instruction
programs.deadline: May 15 (cycle year not stated); earlier priority date for school aid.
programs.fee: Not confirmed on official pages (~$80 per a third-party listing).
programs.sop: Two-part personal statement (background/fit; goals/research interests) + a third doctoral essay question. Length not stated.
programs.funding: Mostly self-funded / part-time. Limited GSE assistantships cover one course per semester for ~100 hours of work.
programs.cohort: Not stated. Requires a master's + 2 years teaching.

programs.deadline: Not stated for this program (Kean-wide: Dec 1 on-campus, Apr 1 international/priority). Ask gradadmissions@kean.edu.
programs.funding: Self-funded, part-time 3-year cohort (online + summer institutes). No assistantships stated.
